control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60, check the line tracker; otherwise call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70, check the side obstacle sensors; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70, drive forward; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: In dim light, follow a black line when the line tracker is on it and drive straight where there is none; in bright light, follow the line as before.
